name: agentic-monday-apps-framework
description: SDLC toolkit for building monday.com code apps - from initialization to deployment

plugins.name: monday-code-init
plugins.description: Initialize new monday code projects (frontend/backend/fullstack) with proper structure, dependencies, and monday-code configuration

plugins.name: monday-code-dev
plugins.description: Development workflows - run dev servers, local Document DB, tunnel setup for monday code apps

plugins.name: monday-code-migrate
plugins.description: Migrate existing frontend, backend, or fullstack apps to monday-code platform — build-tool agnostic, preserves existing code

plugins.name: monday-code-deploy
plugins.description: Build, deploy, and manage monday code apps on serverless/CDN with multi-region, cron, alerts, and security scanning
